items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: me and Granger and Elizabeth's brother-in-law

ctx.x: Never forgot him for that either. But it was great. Now we had a guitar player. This guitar player I'm telling you about, Luke Stewart, he would go out, he had a little more experience than we did, because he didn't come up in that band. He come up with the other guys. So he knew a little bit more about getting around. So he would go to a hotel called the Vendome Hotel, which was in the black neighborhood, in the Harlem part of Buffalo, and he'd go in there and play for tips. And he would come back and he would…

So nothing happened for us in Buffalo, because in the first place he was in a big hurry to get away. He wanted to go back home. He didn't have no eyes for that. So I said, "Well, we'll go back to Cleveland." See the only reason I wanted to go back to Cleveland was because my wife's aunt had a home there, and out of Horace's band, me and Granger and Elizabeth's brother-in-law, who was -- her nephew, you know.
